entities.name: Yolotzin
entities.description: A revered human warrior-poet of Ixalan from the nascent Sun Empire, who became the empire's moral and artistic voice and imperial conscience.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Empire whose capital Yolotzin was taken to and whose emperor named her warrior-poet.

entities.name: Emperor
entities.description: Gave Yolotzin the title of warrior-poet and mourned her death in Tocatli.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: Halls where the emperor wandered mourning Yolotzin.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: Listener of Huatli's story of Yolotzin.

events.summary: Yolotzin's village is conquered and her family killed; her voice and linguistic skill lead to her being taken to the capital.
events.quote: Her village was conquered, and her family was killed

events.summary: The emperor names Yolotzin warrior-poet and imperial conscience.
events.quote: she earned the title of warrior-poet from the emperor, serving as the imperial conscience

events.summary: Yolotzin dies and the empire mourns deeply.
events.quote: When she passed away, the empire mourned deeply.

events.summary: Huatli tells Yolotzin's story to Saheeli as a lesson in resilience.
events.quote: Huatli recounted Yolotzin’s story to Saheeli to illustrate a legacy of resilience and determination.

relations.quote: She became the moral and artistic voice of the empire
